title: Atong Ang used ‘backdoor’ to leave Philippines—Remulla
summary: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Tuesday confirmed that fugitive businessman Charlie “Atong” Ang used a “backdoor” route to leave the country and evade authorities.
